rows.note: Use 完全 as the all-purpose choice for saying that something is complete or wholly so.

example.english: I was altogether unable to understand what he meant.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jyun4 cyun4 m4 ming4 keoi5 soeng2 gong2 mat1

rows.note: Use 總共 when adding every item together to give a total, especially for amounts or bills.

example.english: There were six people altogether at this table.
example.traditional: 呢張枱總共坐咗六個人。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 toi2 zung2 gung6 co5 zo2 luk6 go3 jan4

rows.note: Use 真係 before an adjective or evaluation when altogether means really or clearly, rather than completely.

example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 zan1 hai6 hou2 tai2

rows.note: Use 整體嚟講 when giving an overall judgment after considering everything.

example.english: The trip was altogether quite enjoyable.
example.traditional: 整體嚟講，今次旅行都幾開心。
example.jyutping: zing2 tai2 lai4 gong2 gam1 ci3 leoi5 hang4 dou1 gei2 hoi1 sam1
